templates.coverage: 28 source templates; source fallback and populated JSON catalog; cached-v1 initialization with real verified owner-media upload, CAS and lost ACK; language/version preservation

canvasBrowser.coverage: All 243 library definitions save/read; 243 thumbnails/insertions/one-step undo; effects and 10 public interactions; full editor, paid photo flow, failed upload preservation, creator permissions, recovery, locale, optional photo and old two-envelope control. Some historical outer test labels still say 172; the actual inventory assertion and browser output are 243/243.

longCopy.desktopZoom: 200% emulation: 720 CSS px / 1440 physical px, DPR 2

journeys.photos: Both optional photo templates: no user image, landscape, portrait, focus/crop and replacement

editor.coverage: Select text and principal object; fully decoded Studio/Fabric captures; edit/save geometry; source/policy preserved; crop UI and undo for both photo templates

newLibrary.coverage: Insert all, owner-private asset materialization, save/reload, filters, publish, guest asset ACL, public bytes match, keyboard foldout, normal motion and live reduced-motion stop; inserting stock graphics does not change the appearance of an unrelated reply form

mysql.coverage: Admin customization conflict; no partial writes on initial conflict; stale revision rejected; 7+68 resume; rerun; rollback; history; 5+7 external-element resume/rollback; 21 real MySQL HTTP/browser cases with mocked external providers

controls.method: Pinned original default documents byte-for-byte; actual Chrome before/after cover pairs and broad runtime browser checks

unverified: individual Fabric screenshots of every legacy element
